label_en: Upper secondary school (gymnasieskola), higher-education-preparatory programmes as baseline
summary: Students aged about 16-19. The law requires the premises and equipment the education needs (Skollagen 2 kap. 35 §), a staffed school library on the school's own unit (2 kap. 24 a §, from 2025-07-01) and elevhälsa (2 kap. 25 §). Unlike grundskola, Skollagen has no school-meal requirement for gymnasieskolan, so dining is practice, not law. Outdoor friyta is required only 'i skälig utsträckning' (BFS 2015:1), and older students are expected to use parks and squares. That makes gymnasieskola the school type that best fits a dense office building. Area benchmarks are thin. Hässleholm's riktvärden are 12 m²/student for theoretical programmes, 15 for combined and 18 for practical (vocational). Stockholm schools are reported at about 11-14 m² BRA per student. Vocational programmes (variant) add workshops with heavy services, vehicle access and floor-load needs.

regulatory.bbr_verksamhetsklass_source: BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 11-12 §§ (spaces for pupils in schools; split at 150 persons). Workshops in vocational programmes may contain spaces closer to Vk1 (industrial) and spaces with high fire risk. General fire rules and travel distances are in cross_cutting.json.

key_laws.ref: Skollagen 2 kap. 24 a-24 d §§ (skolbibliotek on own skolenhet, staffed; gymnasieskolan explicitly included), SFS 2024:1072, in force 2025-07-01
Skollagen 15 kap. 17 § (gymnasieskolan is free of charge; no meal requirement, unlike 10 kap. 10 § for grundskola)
PBL 8 kap. 9-11 §§ and BFS 2015:1 FRI (friyta for gymnasieskolor 'placeras och ordnas på det sätt som är skäligt')
AFS 2023:12 Utformning av arbetsplatser, kap. 3 (personalutrymmen); details in cross_cutting.json
Förordning (EG) nr 852/2004 (if a school kitchen or café is run)

permits: Bygglov for change of use (PBL 9 kap. 15 § 1, from 2025-12-01; see cross_cutting.json), tested against the detaljplan (S) and PBL 8 kap. 9 § friyta 'skäligt'
Anmälan för hälsoskydd to the municipal environment committee before start (FMH 38 §)
Food establishment registration if a kitchen or café is run (EU 852/2004 art. 6)
For an independent school: Skolinspektionen approval of the huvudman
Vocational variant: possible environmental permits or notifications for workshops (e.g. vehicle, painting). Not researched here.

gross_m2_per_unit.measure: not stated by Hässleholm; Stockholm figures are BRA
gross_m2_per_unit.source: Hässleholms kommun, Lokalförsörjningsplan 2022-2026, p. 27: riktvärden 12 m²/elev for teoretiska program, 15 m²/elev for kombinerade program and 18 m²/elev for praktiska program (actual stock 27.8 m²/elev). Stockholm stad 'Skola för skola' table reports about 11.3 (Kungsholmens gymnasium), 13.3 (Hässelby) and 14.0 (Thorildsplan) kvm BRA per student. The Stockholm figures come from a search summary of an undated bilaga and were not re-checked.

group_size.source: No legal class size. Classroom dimensioning for 30-35 students is common practice; not found in a reviewed source.

staff_per_unit.source: About 12.5 students per full-time teacher in gymnasieskola, 2024/25 (Skolverket, 'Pedagogisk personal i skola och vuxenutbildning läsåret 2024/25'). Skolverket no longer publishes the ratio as an official series. Figure from a search summary, not re-checked.

occupancy.hourly_presence_note: Lower peak than grundskola because of free periods, elective courses and APL (workplace-based learning) days in vocational programmes. Adult education (komvux) often shares buildings in the evening.

required.basis: Skollagen 2 kap. 35 § (premises needed). The law gives no size.

size.source: No gymnasium-specific classroom norm found. By analogy, Uppsala's grundskola programme requires lärosalar of at least 60 m² (2015 p. 11). Malmö miljöförvaltningen recommends at least 65 m² per 30 pupils (Malmö friyta guideline p. 13). Uppsala 2019 states that only the kitchen, restaurant, idrott and elevhälsa parts of its grundskola programme apply to gymnasieskolor (p. 4).

spaces.shareable_note: Evening komvux, folkbildning and conference use.
spaces.notes: The closest school type to office floor plates. Lecture-hall-type rooms for 60-120 students are common in larger schools (practice, unsourced).

spaces.label_en: Science labs (natural science and technology programmes)

required.basis: Laboratory work is part of the course syllabi in biology, chemistry and physics. Skollagen 2 kap. 35 § requires the needed premises and equipment. Needed only where those programmes are offered.

size.source: No gymnasium lab norm found. Uppsala's grundskola NO lab is 105-170 m² per school (2019 p. 27), shown only for reference.

spaces.notes: Fume cupboards need their own exhaust risers, and ventilated chemical storage is needed. These are the services hot-spot of a theoretical-programme school.

required.basis: Skollagen 2 kap. 24 a § (from 2025-07-01): gymnasieskolan pupils shall have access to a school library on their own skolenhet. Exceptions only for särskilda skäl stated in the biblioteksplan (24 c §). 24 d §: staffed.

size.source: No gymnasium library size found. Uppsala grundskola: 80-120 m² (2019 p. 27), for reference only.

spaces.notes: Many gymnasieskolor in rented city premises previously relied on the public library. From 2025-07-01 that needs särskilda skäl, so an on-site library becomes a real space requirement in conversions.

required.basis: Skollagen 2 kap. 25 § (elevhälsa, including access to skolläkare, skolsköterska, psykolog, kurator, specialpedagog/speciallärare)

size.count: per school; by analogy with Uppsala grundskola (60-75 m² incl. rest room and RWC)
size.source: Uppsala 2019 funktionsprogram p. 4: the elevhälsa requirements AR: T.6-T.10 also apply to gymnasieskolor. The area (lokalprogram p. 27) is set for grundskola, so its use here is by analogy.

required.basis: Skollagen has no meal requirement for gymnasieskolan (15 kap. 17 § covers fees only; chapter 15 never mentions måltider). Most municipalities offer free lunch as a local decision. Uppsala 2019 p. 4 applies its restaurant requirements to gymnasieskolor.

size.count: enrolled students (BRA), by analogy with Uppsala grundskola
size.source: Uppsala 2019 lokalprogram översikt p. 27 (grundskola matsal 0.5 m² BRA per pupil). Restaurant functional requirements RE: T-O (p. 24) apply to gymnasium.

spaces.shareable_note: Could be an existing nearby restaurant under contract. Uppsala RE: F.1 wants it usable for other activities.
spaces.notes: Because meals are not legally required, a conversion can rely on an external restaurant or a receiving kitchen. This is a major freedom compared with grundskola.

spaces.label_en: Kitchen (cooking or receiving) — if meals are served

required.basis: Only if meals are served on site. Then EU 852/2004 and registration apply (law).

size.count: students (BRA), by analogy with Uppsala grundskola 'Måltidsverksamhet'
size.source: Uppsala 2019 lokalprogram översikt p. 27; kitchen functional requirements KÖ (pp. 22-23) apply to gymnasium per p. 4

constraints.grease_separator_required: cooking kitchen: normally yes (ABVA; SS-EN 1825); receiving: municipality-dependent

spaces.notes: Registration at least two weeks before start (Livsmedelsverket). See variants in school_compulsory for cooking vs receiving kitchens.

spaces.label_en: Sports hall access with changing rooms

required.basis: Idrott och hälsa is a course common to all national programmes (gymnasiegemensamt ämne; the exact provision in Gymnasieförordningen (2010:2039) or its annex was not verified). Skollagen 2 kap. 35 § requires access to needed premises. Ownership is not required, and halls are commonly hired.

size.source: No gymnasium norm found. Uppsala 2019 p. 4 applies its idrott functional requirements (ID, pp. 25-26) to gymnasium but gives area only for grundskola (1.0 m² BRA per pupil). Malmö hall sizes 18 × 26 m (gymnastikhall) / 20 × 40 m (sporthall), p. 13.

spaces.notes: Normally off-site in converted buildings. An on-site fitness or movement room (smaller span) is a common compromise, but that is practice and unsourced.

size.source: No gymnasium norm found. Uppsala grundskola uses 0.4 m² BRA per pupil (2019 p. 27); applying it here would be an untested analogy.

spaces.label_en: Staff room, staff WC and changing

size.source: AFS sets functions and counts, not m²

spaces.label_en: Administration, principal, study and career guidance

required.basis: Operational need; study and career guidance is a statutory function (Skollagen 2 kap., paragraph not verified here) but needs no specific room by law
Students with free periods need somewhere to be, since the friyta can be off-site

spaces.notes: Often provided as widened circulation, a library or café zone.

required.basis: Follows from Skollagen 2 kap. 35 § and accessibility rules (cross_cutting.json)

size.source: No gymnasium norm found. Uppsala grundskola uses 0.3-0.4 m² BRA per pupil, for reference.

spaces.label_en: Storage, cleaning, plant rooms, waste and goods reception

required.basis: Operational need; waste and loading space follows from PBL 8 kap. 9 §

size.source: No gymnasium norm found. Uppsala grundskola: varumottagning/källsortering/avfall 70 m² fixed; plant 0.7 m² BRA per pupil (2019 p. 27), for reference.

required.basis: Malmö friyta guideline p. 12: there must always be space for bicycle parking and HKP parking next to a gymnasieskola

size.source: No m² found; cycle parking norms are municipal

required.basis: PBL 8 kap. 9 § andra stycket applies to school tomter. BFS 2015:1 (as quoted in Boverket rapport 2015:8 p. 44 and Malmö p. 12): 'För gymnasieskolor bör friytan placeras och ordnas på det sätt som är skäligt med hänsyn till elevernas och verksamhetens behov.'

size.source: No number in Boverket guidance for gymnasieskolor. Malmö (p. 12) tests need case by case: older students can use parks, squares etc.

spaces.notes: The main reason gymnasieskola is the most office-compatible school type.

variants.label: Vocational programmes (yrkesprogram)
variants.changes: Adds programme-specific workshops, e.g. vehicle hall (Fordon och transport), construction hall (Bygg och anläggning), electrical, industrial, restaurant kitchen and dining for Restaurang- och livsmedelsprogrammet, salon rooms (Hantverk), care practice rooms (Vård och omsorg). These need large spans, high floor loads (imposed loads per BFS 2024:6, see cross_cutting.json), extraction, three-phase power, vehicle doors and goods access. Area benchmark: Hässleholm riktvärde 18 m²/student for practical and 15 for combined programmes (Lokalförsörjningsplan 2022-2026 p. 27). Teaching restaurant kitchens are food establishments under EU 852/2004. No space norms for individual programmes were found; see open_questions.

variants.label: No kitchen on site
variants.changes: Allowed in law. Students eat at a contracted restaurant or the school issues meal cards. Removes kitchen and most dining area, but most municipal huvudmän offer lunch as policy.

variants.label: Mottagningskök
variants.changes: As for school_compulsory: reduced exhaust, grease separator depends on the municipality, still registered.

typical_blockers: Library must be on site from 2025-07-01 (2 kap. 24 a §) unless särskilda skäl apply.
Science labs need fume-cupboard exhaust risers.
Egress capacity for hundreds of students moving between lessons; Vk2B over 150 persons.
Vocational workshops: floor load, spans, vehicle access and extraction rarely fit an office frame.
Detaljplan change from office use to S (skola).
typical_enablers: Friyta only 'skäligt'. City-centre parks and squares are accepted in practice (Malmö p. 12).
No legal meal requirement, so external dining is possible.
Classroom and workroom sizes are close to office cellular and open-plan modules.

open_questions: No public gymnasium lokalprogram with room-by-room m² was found (searched Göteborg, Stockholm and Uppsala). Hässleholm's riktvärden are the only per-student norm; the area measure (BRA/LOA/BTA) is not stated in the passage. Ask Stockholm (SISAB) or Göteborg (Lokalförvaltningen) for their gymnasium programmes.
Verify the Stockholm 'Skola för skola' kvm/elev figures (11.3-14.0 BRA) directly in the source; they came from a search summary.
Find the exact provision making Idrott och hälsa a gymnasiegemensamt ämne (Gymnasieförordningen 2010:2039 or annex; check after the 2025 gymnasium reform toward ämnesbetyg).
Vocational programmes: no Skolverket space norms were found. Check whether Skolverket or the national programme councils (nationella programråd) publish equipment and premises guidance per programme.
Confirm the Skollagen paragraph for studie- och yrkesvägledning (cited without paragraph here).
Check whether municipalities count free gymnasium lunch as a binding local decision for a given pilot city, since it decides whether a kitchen is required in practice.
